अर्घ्, i. 1, Par. To be worth, Pañc. i. d. 88.
 --Cf. अर्ह्, ἄρχω, ὄρχαμος, ἄρχομαι, ἄργμα.

अर्घ् + अ (vb. अर्घ् or अर्ह्), m. and n.
 1. Price, cost,
. A mode of worship, or reverence, consisting in an oblation of rice, etc., with water or, of water only,
अर्घ + तस्, adv. Under the real value,

अर्घ्य, i. e. अर्घ + य.
 I. adj., f. या.
 1. Deserving worship, Yājñ. 1, 357.
 2. Deserving to be entertained, ib. 1, 110.
 II. n. A respectful oblation to gods or venerable men, consisting of rice, durva grass, flowers, etc., with water, or of water only, Yājñ. 1, 289.
 --Comp.
+ प्रक्षेपण अर्घ- + प्रक्षेपण, n. fixing the prices, Yājñ. 2, 201.
